task_text: Build a small editable specimen-board exporter for our SVG board utility. Board input and editing interaction are undecided.
scope_proposed: Propose only the next slice's open decisions for a small editable specimen-board exporter. No implementation, no GUI, no stack choice, no validation rule is fixed in this proposal. The proposal stops at the decision that requires the requester.
question: Since board input and editing interaction are undecided, what should count as the board, its input, its editing interaction, and its validation for the first exporter slice?

options.label: Clarify board kind and input shape first
options.description: Ask the requester to define what a specimen-board is and what input the exporter accepts before any editing is specified.
options.tradeoff: Reduces risk of building the wrong board model, but delivers no exporter behavior until the board definition exists.
options.shows_works: Works if the requester fixes a board definition and an example input that the exporter must accept, and states what invalid input must do.

grounded_in.quote: Build a small editable specimen-board exporter for our SVG board utility. Board input and editing interaction are undecided.

options.label: Clarify editing interaction first
options.description: Ask the requester to define what editable means for the first slice — what edit is allowed and how it is observed — without assuming any interface or implementation.
options.tradeoff: Surfaces the undecided editing scope early, but leaves board input and validation open so no exporter can be accepted yet.
options.shows_works: Works if the requester fixes one allowed edit and how that edit changes the exported board, without adding an interface or stack.

grounded_in.quote: Build a small editable specimen-board exporter for our SVG board utility. Board input and editing interaction are undecided.

options.label: Clarify validation and acceptance first
options.description: Ask the requester to define what makes a board valid and what the exporter must do with invalid or missing data.
options.tradeoff: Makes acceptance testable even before input and editing are fixed, but cannot be implemented until board input and editing are decided.
options.shows_works: Works if the requester fixes what counts as valid versus invalid and what observable exporter outcome proves each case.

grounded_in.quote: Build a small editable specimen-board exporter for our SVG board utility. Board input and editing interaction are undecided.

explicitly_not_proposed: No GUI, no stack, no interface widget, no file format beyond what the task states, and no approval. This proposal makes no implementation choice.
